name: Pic de Rhumsiki (Monts Mandara)
Description: A spectacular and iconic volcanic spire offering a unique lunar landscape in the heart of the Mandara Mountains.
bonASavoir: The actual cost: The basic entrance fee to Mount Cameroon National Park is approximately 5,000 FCFA. The reality on the ground: It is strictly forbidden and dangerous to hike alone. You must go through the ecotourism office in Buea. A complete 2-3 day trek (including the park permit, mandatory guide, porters, and food) generally costs between 25,000 and 35,000 FCFA per day for a solo hiker, and all-inclusive agency packages range from 150,000 to 375,000 FCFA.
